parameters.query:
SELECT
  'kpi-snapshot' AS metric_id,
  total_enquiries,
  total_pipeline_value AS pipeline_value,
  avg_lead_score,
  avg_response_time_secs AS avg_response_time,
  avg_classification_confidence AS avg_confidence,
  avg_pax_total,
  enquiries_last_hour AS enquiries_hour,
  pipeline_last_hour AS pipeline_hour,
  count_immediate,
  count_important,
  count_not_important,
  count_website,
  count_chatbot,
  count_considering,
  count_enquiring,
  count_shortlisting,
  last_updated_at AS last_updated
FROM powerbi_realtime_kpis
WHERE id = 1;
